key_insight: Independent reproduction and external benchmarking show that RXNGraphormer is both reproducible and broadly transferable for reaction prediction. However, its performance drops in heterogeneous or distribution-shifted settings, highlighting clear limits to robustness.
problem_solved: This paper addresses whether RXNGraphormer can be reliably reproduced by others and whether its reported performance generalizes to external datasets beyond the original benchmark conditions.
method: Conducted an independent reproduction of the RXNGraphormer results.
Evaluated the model on external benchmark datasets for reaction prediction.
Compared performance under standard conditions versus heterogeneous and distribution-shifted scenarios.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, this study provides evidence that RXNGraphormer can be trusted in familiar settings while also identifying where caution is needed. It reinforces the importance of reproducibility checks and external validation before deployment.
visual_elements: Split-panel comparison of original results vs independent reproduction
Performance bar chart across multiple external reaction datasets
Shift/robustness diagram showing performance under distribution shift
Icon set for reproducibility, transferability, and limitations
paper_title: Reusability report: Assessment of reproducibility and applicability to external datasets for RXNGraphormer
paper_authors: Chonghuan Zhang, Majian Zeng, Qianghua Lin, Kuangbiao Liao
